title: 9tz.3: Command::Search parsing in command.rs
description:
What: Add Command::Search variant to the NNTP command enum and parser.

Algorithm:
1. In crates/reader/src/session/command.rs add to Command enum:
   /// SEARCH <key> <value>
   /// Non-standard extension following INN convention; advertised in CAPABILITIES.
   /// Requires active group context (like OVER).
   Search { key: SearchKey, value: String },
2. Define SearchKey enum:
   #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
   pub enum SearchKey { Subject, From, Body, Text, Since, Before }
   impl FromStr for SearchKey with variants subject/from/body/text/since/before (case-insensitive).
3. In parse_command() match arm "SEARCH":
   - Split rest by first whitespace → (key_str, value_str)
   - Validate key_str via SearchKey::from_str; return Err for unknown key
   - Value is rest of line (trimmed)
   - Return Command::Search { key, value }
4. Ensure match in dispatch.rs compiles (add a stub arm returning 500 or placeholder — actual impl is in 9tz.7).

Defensive rules: Unknown search key → return command-syntax error (501). Empty value → return command-syntax error. Value length checked at dispatch time, not parse time.

Tests: Parse valid 'SEARCH SUBJECT rust' → correct variant; 'SEARCH BODY hello world' captures full value; 'SEARCH BADKEY x' → parse error.
